question: is the conserved-core decoder's cross-organism decay (A) continuous with phylogenetic distance or (B) a cliff at the eukaryote boundary?
primary_metric: coverage_lift = coverage(essential) - coverage(non-essential); class-conditioned so base-rate robust and cross-rung comparable

preregistered.question: is the conserved-core decoder's cross-organism decay (A) continuous with phylogenetic distance or (B) a cliff at the eukaryote boundary?
preregistered.primary_metric: coverage_lift = coverage(essential) - coverage(non-essential); class-conditioned so base-rate robust and cross-rung comparable
preregistered.secondary_metric: AUROC -- reported but NOT compared across rungs (different sampling frames; 83% tie mass in human makes it a tie-mass statistic)
preregistered.primary_test_reason: the three bacterial rungs are all transposon-insertion screens, so distance varies while label TECHNOLOGY is held constant
preregistered.falsified_if: coverage_lift does not clear its own label-permutation null on the rungs that score
preregistered.eukaryote_tie: S. cerevisiae and H. sapiens share equal lineage depth with E. coli (1), so they are one distance class; their SPREAD is a consistency check, not a rung ordering
preregistered.decoder_must_be_unchanged: a per-organism synonym layer would destroy the transfer condition; sha256(core_decoder.py) is pinned by test
preregistered.frozen_at: plan v2 Step 1, before any new rung was fetched

threshold_derivation.plateau_tol: ceil(max null_MAX across the two existing rungs) = ceil(0.0581) -> 0.06; the null MAX rather than p95, matching this repo's practice of clearing the maximum
threshold_derivation.cliff_drop: 2 x plateau_tol -> 0.12; a drop must be twice the noise floor to be a cliff
threshold_derivation.min_rungs: 3; two rungs are the motivating observation, not a shape
threshold_derivation.non_vacuity: 0.1492 > cliff_drop 0.12 (a cliff is reachable) and > plateau_tol 0.06 (a plateau is not trivially satisfied)
threshold_derivation.HONEST_LABEL: DESCRIPTIVE-CONSISTENCY LOCK, not a frozen-before-the-numbers endpoint test: these are derived from the two rungs that motivated the question, so a bar built from them cannot also test them.

phrasing_floor.floor_is_a_FLOOR_not_an_estimate: this is a FLOOR, not an estimate: 57 genes survived an adversarial bar on the human rung, the true mechanism-(ii) share sits between ~0.10 and ~0.25, and vocabulary overlap cannot narrow it -- so the adjustment deliberately UNDER-corrects
